lines.en: I crushed a clutch of frog eggs.

lines.zh: 再往前一点，就是深泥了。
lines.en: A little farther and the mud gets deep.
Soaking in mud, I never tire.
Bones are stirring in the reeds.
My shadow lags a step; my feet arrive first.

lines.zh: 沼泽里太湿，骨头都在响
lines.en: The swamp's so wet my bones creak
The mud swallowed the sound of my steps.
Whispers... just wind through the reeds.
Mud rises over my bones.

lines.zh: 我贴着水皮走，你没听见。
lines.en: I skim the water's skin and you hear nothing.
Seven steps remain across the mud.
In the swamp mud, I hide.

lines.zh: 泥里的气泡声不是我弄的。
lines.en: The bubbles in the mud are not mine.
In swamp fog I show no shape.
My shadow has sunk into the mud.
Leave me be; let me soak.
Bones soaking in mud feel nice.
I count the duckweed and lose count halfway.
This room is watching me.
I breathe in, and only marsh gas comes.

lines.zh: 我隐在沼泽的雾里，你找不到。
lines.en: I hide in the swamp mist where you cannot find me.
The petals hums softly.
There used to be a door in this swamp.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾，替我遮住身子。
lines.en: The swamp mist hides my body.
Only gnats circle by my ear.

lines.zh: 快倒下时，我会叫来幻影。
lines.en: When I near death, I call phantoms.
At last you raise your head in the mist.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面，先暗了一块。
lines.en: A patch of the swamp darkens first.
In the swamp mist, I vanish first.
Are you searching the mud for my bones?
You turned your head, and the muddy water moved.

lines.zh: 骨架子站在这个距离最好。
lines.en: The skeleton's best range is exactly this.

lines.zh: 我隐身站在沼泽里，看着你。
lines.en: I stand invisible in the swamp, watching.
I see you, Bogged Bone Stalker.
Your reflection in the muddy water is trembling.
So this is what a living person looks like.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后那片雾。
lines.en: I have always been in the mist behind you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛照得泥沼发亮。
lines.en: Your eyes make the bog glow.
You stare at the mud, and I stare at you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾散了，我才露出来。
lines.en: The bog mist parts, and I show myself.
In the swamp, we meet again.
The hand holding your lantern is swaying.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，我先瞎你的眼。
lines.en: In the swamp fog, I blind you first.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，我们慢慢聊。
lines.en: In the swamp fog, let us talk slowly.

lines.zh: 你也敢碰我这具湿骨头。
lines.en: You dare touch these waterlogged bones.
That blow scattered the mist itself.

lines.zh: 血还是热的，这泥沼也热。
lines.en: The blood's still warm, and so is this bog.
I am still soaking in the mud, not fallen.

lines.zh: 痛从骨缝里渗出来，凉的。
lines.en: Pain seeps cold from my bone seams.

lines.zh: 泡过沼泽的骨头，更结实。
lines.en: Bones soaked in swamp come out tougher.
See? Even bog bones crumble.
You snapped one of my ribs.
Stop — my bones rattle too loud.
Pain gathers in my chest like marsh gas.
Do not put that lantern away.

lines.zh: 你那点光，照不穿我的隐身。
lines.en: Your little light cannot pierce my cloak.

lines.zh: 你掉进泥里的东西，我捡了。
lines.en: I picked up what you dropped in the mud.
What are you using that for?

lines.zh: 沼泽里我一隐身，你就瞎了。
lines.en: One vanish in the swamp and you're blind.
Lower the lantern, then back up to the bank.

lines.zh: 你手里那团亮的是什么？
lines.en: What is that bright thing in your hand?
That light is calling me through the marsh gas.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，盖住我的脚印。
lines.en: Swamp mud covers my tracks.
That thing is more interesting than you.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我身上的水草。
lines.en: You knocked the weeds off me.
One collision, and the muddy water is enough.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我贴着你了。
lines.en: You can't see me. I'm against you.
An apology will not sink into this mud.
The swamp mist hides me.
I sank into the mud; you back away too.

lines.zh: 只是碰了下，你退得真快。
lines.en: It was only a touch, yet you backed off so fast.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，别装没感觉。
lines.en: You touched me — don't pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 泥下的骨头比你想的硬。
lines.en: Bones under the mud are harder than you think.
The living should not touch bog bones.

lines.zh: 快死的时候，影子会来帮我。
lines.en: Near death, shadows come to help me.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么湿，骨头都发软。
lines.en: This swamp is so damp my bones go soft.
Two bog skeletons, soaking together.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾，正好遮我的骨头
lines.en: The swamp mist hides my bones nicely
Not so fast; soak in the mud with me first.
I have no heartbeat, only marsh gas.
Be my shadow.

lines.zh: 水涨水落，我都在泥里等。
lines.en: Through floods and droughts, I wait in the mud.

lines.zh: 我会浮在你旁边的水草间。
lines.en: I will float in the weeds beside you.
We are both down to a frame of bones.
The mud always buries something good.

lines.zh: 我给你留了点东西在泥里。
lines.en: I left something for you in the mud.

lines.zh: 从泥里捡起来，就不算丢。
lines.en: Fished out of the mud, it is not lost.
I counted. Seven pieces in the mud.
I will fish one thing out of the mud.
Got it. Back into the mud.

lines.zh: 泥沼里那根骨头，是我掉的。
lines.en: That bone in the bog is one I dropped.

lines.zh: 它刚沉下来，还带着凉意。
lines.en: It just sank here and still feels cool.

lines.zh: 这块小骨，正好塞进泥缝。
lines.en: This little bone fits right into a mud crack.
This petals is almost mine.
Your boot prints are sunk in the soft mud.
So the stirring in the mud was you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾里，我就在你影子里。
lines.en: In the swamp fog, I'm inside your shadow.
One living person is enough to soak me for a long while.
It is you; the marsh gas knows you.
There is a heartbeat under the water sound.
The marsh gas has picked up the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 沼泽里，我隐身等了两百多年。
lines.en: In the swamp, I've waited unseen two centuries.
I vanished in the swamp mist.

lines.zh: 骨头贴在泥上，一点声都没有。
lines.en: Bone on mud makes no sound.
From now on, the mud will follow you.
You cannot leave this reed marsh.

lines.zh: 雾一起来，我的轮廓就散了。
lines.en: When the fog rises, my outline fades.

lines.zh: 你的倒影已经沉在我手里。
lines.en: Your reflection has already sunk into my hands.
The mud will remember the path you took.
Found you in the swamp.

lines.zh: 还有几步？泥已经到腰了。
lines.en: How many more steps? The mud is at your waist.

lines.zh: 我一直在那棵枯柳后面。
lines.en: I have been behind that dead willow all along.
I am still in the mist, not far behind.

lines.zh: 你把我引进了更深的沼。
lines.en: You led me into an even deeper bog.
I have been at the corner all along.

lines.zh: 我隐身了，你听见的只是水声
lines.en: I've gone unseen — what you hear is only water
I follow the weeds at my own pace.
Do not panic; the mud is in no hurry either.
Near death, I call phantoms.
Do not run; the mud will trip you.

lines.zh: 前面是泥潭，踩下去就没了。
lines.en: Ahead is a mud pit; step in and you are gone.
I need not run; the mud will hold you.
The more you run, the clearer I hear.

lines.zh: 我看不见的地方，你也别想看。
lines.en: Where I can't be seen, you won't see either.
Close your eyes; the blinding is me.
I know this swamp better than you do.
Left? The reeds are already bent that way.
Pause a moment; let me rise to the surface.
Do not struggle; the more you move, the deeper you sink.
Sorry, the swamp taught me this.
Pull your foot out of the mud.
The mud holds you; I will not.
Do not hide; my blinding comes fast.

lines.zh: 隐身之后，你的影子还在。
lines.en: Invisible, but your shadow stays.
I count to three, and the mud swallows you.
I blind you first, then strike.
Whispers rise from under the mud!

lines.zh: 我的骨手，一次能抓很紧。
lines.en: My bone hand grips hard in one go.
Your footsteps are too loud.

lines.zh: 我的骨手从雾里伸出来，很快。
lines.en: My bone hand reaches out of the mist, quick.
The fog closes, and it is over.
Sorry — it is instinct.
Bone on bone — you asked for it.

lines.zh: 沼泽泥里伸出的骨头，抓到你了。
lines.en: Bones reach out of the bog mud and find you.
Iron rust has mixed into the marsh gas.
It is just dark enough here to hide bones.

lines.zh: 我一隐身，你就看不见了。
lines.en: One blink and I vanish.
That lantern cannot reach the bottom of the bog.

lines.zh: 我的影子被水草缠住了。
lines.en: My shadow is tangled in the water weeds.

lines.zh: 濒死时，我召来幻影潜行者。
lines.en: Near death, I call the phantom stalkers.

lines.zh: 二百二十五点，够我慢慢走。
lines.en: Two hundred and twenty-five points. I can afford to walk slow.
Who is breathing in the mist?

lines.zh: 我数了，沼边只有你一个。
lines.en: I counted. You are the only one at the bog's edge.
Which pool of mud should I soak in?

lines.zh: 我一出现，你的眼睛就暗了。
lines.en: When I come, your sight goes dark.
Someone is stepping on the reeds at the muddy bank.
I vanish and you go blind.
The mist has not lifted; I can wait.
The swamp fog arrives, then me.
My name has sunk to the bottom of the bog.

lines.zh: 泥下的低语把我叫醒了。
lines.en: Whispers beneath the mud woke me.
This bog, I remember it.

lines.zh: 沼泽泡软的骨头，最怕火。
lines.en: Swamp-soaked bone fears flame most.
I fell from the dead willow into the bog.

lines.zh: 泥水一灌，骨头都不响了。
lines.en: Once the mud floods in, my bones stop rattling.
The blast set the bog water shaking.
Your arrow sticks in the mud, short of me.
What spell is this?
Bog bubbles rumble like my stomach.

lines.zh: 雷光下，我的影子露了出来。
lines.en: In the lightning, my shadow showed.
There is not even a frog's croak in the void.
